title: Heron River navigation screening
subtitle: Reach from km 12 to km 30
summary: Three design lines were screened through an invented reach of the Heron River. **Option 2** meets every check at the design vessel's draught. All numbers in this example are illustrative.

body.markdown:
This report screens design lines for a navigation channel through the reach. It is a worked example of an Open Report Designer document: every river, number and name in it is invented.

The method is in [[#method]], the results in [[#results]] and the data the results rest on in [[#data]].

Each option is a smooth line inside the river banks. Its bends are checked against the minimum radius, and its depth against the vessel's draught plus clearance. See [[#plan]] for the reach and [[#long-section]] for the bed.

> Screening results rank options. They do not replace a design.
